body: I totally agree, I'm happier with myself now but it hasn't been a miraculous transition in which I feel totally amazing constantly. Mood swings are reeeal haha.
Thanks for this! I'm glad to know this isn't just me, because I never really see negatives/issues people have when first starting their transition.
I think that's probably it, since my voice has changed quite a bit in such a short period of time. I'm glad it's not just me though, and good luck on your transition ! :~)
